backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing access control with admin/user roles, user profiles, coaching topics, goals management, session history, and availability toggling with permission-based authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON summaries of all frontend component files including routing, hooks, UI components, and pages for the coaching application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with AI Coach Voice title, meta description for 24/7 coaching, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up TanStack Router with routes for home and coaching session pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with shared Layout containing Header, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AvailabilityIndi: Badge component displaying 24/7 availability status with animated pulsing indicator fetched from backend query.
frontend/src/components/CoachingDashboar: Main dashboard with prominent start coaching button, hero section, quick-start topic cards, and session history with authentication checks and extensive debug logging.
frontend/src/components/CoachingInput.ts: Combined input component with text field, send button, and voice recorder toggle for submitting messages or voice recordings with keyboard support.
frontend/src/components/CourseCard.tsx: Empty file for course card component.
Empty file for featured courses section component.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedTools.ts: Empty file for featured tools section component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/GoalCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual goal with topic, progress bar, completion percentage, and remove button with mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with AI Coach Voice branding, availability indicator, navigation controls, theme toggle, and authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Displays a chat message bubble with avatar, content, and optional timestamp, styled differently for coach vs. user messages.
frontend/src/components/QuickStartCard.t: Card component that displays a coaching topic and provides a button to start a new session for that topic.
frontend/src/components/SessionCard.tsx: Simple card component that displays a session name with an icon in a hover-responsive layout.
frontend/src/components/VoiceRecorder.ts: Voice recording component with controls for recording, playing, pausing, and deleting audio, displaying duration and state feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login, logout, and identity management with AuthClient integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching availability, coaching topics, session history, goals, and mutations for starting sessions and managing goals.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceRecording.ts: Custom hook managing voice recording state, MediaRecorder API interactions, audio playback, and duration tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and keyframe animations for pulse-ring and slide-up effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CoachingSessionPage.t: Main coaching session page with message chat interface, voice recording support, goal management dialog, and simulated AI coach responses for a specific topic.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page that shows marketing content with features and login button for unauthenticated users, or displays CoachingDashboard for authenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for UI components, and custom animations for accordions and pulse effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features for an AI coaching application, with known issues including non-functional login button and Start Coaching Session button.
